name: HPE Aruba Networking
evidence_summary: HPE positions EdgeConnect SD-WAN as secure SD-WAN and foundation for single-vendor SASE; docs cover orchestrator, appliances and advanced security.
cost_model: Quote-based subscription/appliance/support; MSP-managed options available through partners/providers.
key_differentiators: EdgeConnect SD-WAN (acquired with Silver Peak) is positioned as the foundation for single-vendor SASE alongside Aruba SSE.
Strong heritage in WAN optimisation and packet-level performance engineering.
Tight integration with the broader Aruba campus and branch portfolio (LAN, Wi-Fi, NAC) for buyers consolidating end-to-end networking.
best_fit_for: Enterprises already running Aruba LAN/Wi-Fi who want WAN and SASE under the same operational tooling.
Buyers prioritising application performance and WAN optimisation in addition to standard SD-WAN routing.
Distributed organisations with branch-heavy footprints where Aruba campus presence is already established.
watch_outs: Aruba SSE is newer than the SSE leaders (Zscaler, Netskope); buyers wanting best-of-breed SASE should evaluate the SSE capability set carefully.
Managed delivery is partner-led rather than from HPE directly.
Private global backbone is not vendor-owned; SASE transport uses public cloud gateways.
verification_notes: Capability matrix sourced from Netify internal vendor research (May 2026). Status grades reflect public source evidence only. Confirm via RFP. Qualitative fields (differentiators, best fit, watch-outs) are Netify editorial synthesis based on the evidence summary and capability profile; review before publishing. Extended dimensions (regions, clouds, AI, resilience, deployment speed, sectors, organisation fit, identity, platforms, support, logging) are indicative desk research grades from June 2026; confirm via RFP.

ai_capability.note: Mist AI and Marvis virtual assistant (HPE Juniper); Aruba Central AIOps with EdgeConnect.

resilience.note: EdgeConnect HA, tunnel bonding and orchestrated failover.
